reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

That comes from Priyanka's messages in that channel on 2025-09-03. She said label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so they could see all of this themselves.

I didn't find a street address or any other details about the Southgate site. The incident channel doesn't have one, there are no Tansley account files I can open, and the only GBrain result was a copy of the same channel. I told Tobias that and suggested they check the account record if they need more detail for the call.
